bay.constant_mass_note: all loadouts share the 250 g bay total (case, liner, fill, ballast), so mass properties and the Phase 1 static margin hold for every loadout

GP_HE_FRAG.casualty_radius_definition: radius where a 0.5 m^2 presented human is hit with >=50% probability AND the striking fragment still carries >=58 J; the smaller of the two limits governs
assumptions: Gurney cylinder relation with Comp A5 sqrt(2E) = 2600 m/s
natural fragmentation, ~0.2 g class, half the case mass fragmenting usefully
hemispherical fragment spread, 0.5 m^2 presented area, no terrain masking
GP_HE_FRAG.confidence: MODERATE: closed-form Gurney, drag, and spread estimates; no arena test performed

HEAT.jet_formation: unconfined copper cone, Comp B fill, wave shaper optional
assumptions: hydrodynamic jet penetration P ~ L_jet * sqrt(rho_jet/rho_target)
jet length 1.0-1.5 liner CD, consistent with the P/CD 1.0-2.0 band for charges this size
RHA target at normal incidence, fuze-initiated at 2 CD standoff
HEAT.confidence: MODERATE: calibrated closed-form; shaped-charge performance is highly design-sensitive
HEAT.defeats: APC/IFV side and roof armor (~30-50 mm RHA); not MBT frontal armor

assumptions: Gurney plate relation with a dish liner mass ratio giving 1.6-2.2 km/s
penetration 0.5-0.8 liner CD RHA at 1-50 m standoff (small-EFP literature band)
liner: armco iron or OFHC copper dish
EFP.confidence: LOW-TO-MODERATE: EFP performance scatters widely with liner fabrication; stated as a band
EFP.defeats: light-skinned vehicles and APC roofs at standoff; soft targets out to 50 m

fuze_summary.baseline: contact point-detonating, crush switch plus accelerometer impact sensing, delay-selectable 0/5/10/20 ms
fuze_summary.standoff_option: 5.8 GHz CW Doppler RF proximity module gated 2-6 m for the HEAT loadout optimal standoff
fuze_summary.arming: dual-event S&A: sustained >=2 g launch acceleration AND canard-deployment confirmation AND motor-burn time gate; no single event or stray signal can arm the fire set

basis: closed-form terminal-ballistics estimates at the shared design point; no warhead has been built or detonated
